name: FED Hawkish Pause / Rate Cut Pivot Trap
scenario_description: Traders piled into leveraged longs expecting an immediate March rate cut; however, sticky CPI and hawkish Fed statements sent CME rate cut odds crashing from 85% to 15%.

required_socratic_topics: disconnect between market rate-cut pricing and Fed guidance
cost of capital impact on speculative multiples
DXY strength pressure on crypto beta
